answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital zephyr for network integrity by requiring agents to lock capital to earn voting weight. Like a violet bloom in a harsh climate, this mechanism forces an attacker to purchase significant assets to achieve consensus control. Any attempt to create fake identities results in an ember of wasted capital, as the high opportunity cost of staking assets renders the creation of numerous Sybil nodes financially prohibitive compared to the minimal returns gained from disrupting honest validation.
